name: pdf-form-assistant-backend
description: Node.js + PostgreSQL API for PDF Form Assistant: PDF extraction, field matching, audit

scripts.init-db: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const db = require('./src/db'); db.ensureDatabase().then(() => db.ensureSchema()).then(() => { console.log('schema ready'); process.exit(0); }).catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.test-unit: node scripts/test-normalize.js && node scripts/test-kv-extractor.js && node scripts/test-matcher.js && node scripts/test-yashoda.js
